To determine the chain, we need to follow the rule: after a pair (A, B), the next pair in the chain is the one whose FIRST item is B. We start at oar.

1. (oar, pwc) - The pair (oar, pwc) comes first. Its second item is pwc, so the next pair is the one whose first item is pwc: (pwc, qxe).
2. (pwc, qxe) - The pair (pwc, qxe) comes first. Its second item is qxe, but qxe never appears as a first item - so this is a dangling end of the chain.
